newsitem.title: UK: Insurer Naturesave adds Lloyd's commercial cover.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Naturesave adds Lloyd's commercial cover.

text.p: Green insurance intermediary Naturesave Policies Plc said on Wednesday it was branching out to offer commercial as well as household insurance cover underwritten by Lloyds of London.

"We'll start with small and medium-sized companies with an interest in the environment," managing director Matthew Criddle told Reuters, adding that policyholders would be offered an environmental performance review.

Naturesave was launched in 1994 and now has some 500 policyholders generating around 100,000 stg premium income a year. "We're patient. We're growing slowly, we're getting favourable feedback from clients and I think we're on the way," added Criddle.

All policies are undewritten by Lloyds insurance syndicates. Michael Pritchard of Bankside Syndicates, a part of LIMIT London Insurance Market Investment Trust, will underwrite the commercial policies.

These policies will reflect Naturesave's philosophy that the insurance industry should promote sustainable development. Environmentally aware trading practices make sound financial sense and enhance a company's reputation, Criddle said.

Naturesave had made an underwriting profit every year since launch and has a higher than average business retention rate of 95 percent. "Our policyholders are buying into a long-term idea," Criddle said.
The Oxford-based company contributes 10 percent of premiums to a fund for environmental and conservation projects.
